alt_text: Slide 1 of 6. An anniversary can be difficult even when you were not planning to remember it.
Slide 2 of 6. A date, place, or ordinary object may bring an old chapter into the present.
Slide 3 of 6. Notice what has come up without demanding that the day feel a particular way.
Slide 4 of 6. Consider a manageable plan: company, a familiar task, time outside if suitable, or a conversation with someone supportive.
Slide 5 of 6. If the distress is intense or persistent, seek professional help. You do not have to make the day meaningful by yourself.
Slide 6 of 6. Save this for a date that carries more than the calendar shows.
